title: Use nextest for test runs — never default to cargo test
content: Use nextest for test runs — never default to `cargo test`. The unit-suite gates run under cargo-nextest (`brew install cargo-nextest`): `cargo nextest run --lib` is the mid-cycle gate (~16s; `.config/nextest.toml` quarantines the >45s tests and applies per-test slow-timeouts so newly slow tests get named), and `cargo nextest run --lib --profile full` is the fold/closeout gate running the entire suite. Plain `cargo test --lib` is a no-install fallback only: single-process, ~40x slower, no quarantine or timeouts. Note nextest is process-per-test: `test_env_lock()` no longer serializes there (per-process env isolation supersedes it) but remains required for plain `cargo test`.
